levels.surface: إبراهيم بن عبد الله بن حنين

notes: Braces around «ابن، وهب» are editor marks, kept as the name «ابن، وهب». «- هو ابن بلال -» and «- هو ابن أبي نمر -» are glosses: left out

«قال شريك وأخبرني أبو سلمة» starts a second isnad that keeps the head of the first (the Example 3 rule): Shareek is its second link, Abu Salama the last. The ring saying is carried by this second group
